public.text: The component combines identity records, health-identifier assignment, identifier cross-referencing, matching, and deduplication. These capabilities may be distributed across a client registry, master patient index, identifier service, or identity-management platform.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that the Client Registry is a logical capability and may be realised through several coordinated services, provided authoritative responsibility, interfaces, conformance, and governance remain coherent.
